# Q3 2026 Womenswear Performance Report and Q4 Outlook

## Executive summary
- Net revenue for the Women's department reached $398,405.73 in Q3 2026, marking a 26.2% increase from Q2 2026 ($315,617.28) and an 85.3% surge over Q3 2025 ($214,959.77).
- Growth was driven by an expansion in buying customers (4,693 in Q3 2026 vs. 3,782 in Q2 2026) and higher order volume (5,123 orders vs. 4,000), while average order value remained stable at $77.77.
- New customer acquisition via Search continued to be the primary engine, generating 65.8% of total quarterly revenue ($262,253.95 from new customers).

## Key findings
- **Revenue Growth Across All Quarters:** Net revenue rose by $82,788.45 (+26.2%) quarter-over-quarter from Q2 2026 ($315,617.28) and by $183,445.96 (+85.3%) year-over-year from Q3 2025 ($214,959.77).
- **Order and Customer Expansion:** Orders increased by 28.1% quarter-over-quarter to 5,123 (up from 4,000 in Q2 2026), and buying customers grew by 24.1% to 4,693 (up from 3,782). Average order value (AOV) stayed flat at $77.77 (compared to $78.90 in Q2 2026 and $79.44 in Q3 2025).
- **Top Categories:** Intimates ($39,881.11), Outerwear & Coats ($37,217.15), and Jeans ($35,035.23) led Q3 2026 revenue. Outerwear & Coats saw a sharp 39.6% jump over Q2 2026 ($26,669.72), reflecting seasonal demand shifts.
- **Customer Acquisition Mix:** New customers contributed $262,253.95 (3,033 customers, 3,339 orders), while returning customers generated $136,151.78 (1,660 customers, 1,784 orders). 
- **Traffic Channels:** Search was the dominant acquisition and revenue channel, delivering $278,868.16 across 3,288 buying customers, followed by Organic ($56,776.68) and Facebook ($27,856.54).
- **Return Rates:** Skirts experienced the highest item return rate at 12.8% (26 returns out of 203 items ordered), closely followed by Blazers & Jackets at 12.1% (44 returns out of 365 items ordered). Accessories had the lowest return rate at 7.5%.

## Why it happened
- **Acquisition-Led Growth:** The 26.2% revenue increase was primarily volume-driven. Buying customers increased by 911 quarter-over-quarter, with new customer acquisition remaining robust (3,033 new customers in Q3). 
- **Seasonal Demand Shift:** The increase in Outerwear & Coats ($37,217.15 vs. $26,669.72 in Q2) and Sweaters ($21,606.18 vs. $18,724.55 in Q2) points to early autumn demand heading into the end of Q3. *(Hypothesis to verify: Cooler weather or pre-season merchandising launches triggered earlier autumn browsing.)*
- **Fit and Sizing Friction in Tailored Categories:** Skirts (12.8%) and Blazers & Jackets (12.1%) exhibited the highest return rates, indicating potential sizing or product description inconsistencies in fitted items.

- **Definitions:** 
  - Net revenue = SUM(order_items.sale_price) for items whose status is not 'Cancelled' or 'Returned'.
